name: Helper Official Marketplace
description: Curated official firmware delivery tools, skills, and MCP adapters

plugins.name: firmware-release-evidence
plugins.description: Generate reproducible firmware release evidence (git state, build metadata, test reports, checksums, SBOM refs).
plugins.longDescription: Inspects local git repository dirty state, firmware target board, build exit codes, unit/integration test reports, and generates deterministic release-evidence.json and release-evidence.md reports with SHA-256 binary manifests.
plugins.author: Helper Firmware WG
promptStarters: Inspect the current firmware project and generate structured release-evidence.json and release-evidence.md in ./build/artifacts.
Verify git clean status and validate binary checksums before release staging.

plugins.name: platformio-community
plugins.description: Curated MCP adapter for PlatformIO: device discovery, build, flash preflight, flash, and bounded serial monitor.
plugins.longDescription: PlatformIO Community MCP adapter provides direct integration with PlatformIO toolchains. Supports serial port/board discovery, project environment inspection, compilation, flash preflight with target validation, hardware flashing with explicit confirmation, and bounded serial monitoring.
plugins.author: PlatformIO Community / Helper
promptStarters: Discover connected microcontrollers and list active serial ports.
Run PlatformIO build for target environment nodemcu-32s.
Perform flash preflight check for /dev/ttyUSB0 before firmware flash.

plugins.name: firmware-sbom
plugins.description: Generate CycloneDX / SPDX SBOM and scan embedded components for known vulnerabilities.
plugins.longDescription: Firmware SBOM and vulnerability scanning tool. Generates standard CycloneDX and SPDX Software Bill of Materials for firmware projects, performs offline/online vulnerability cross-referencing against OSV/NVD databases, and outputs license compliance summaries.
plugins.author: Helper Security WG
promptStarters: Generate CycloneDX SBOM for the current firmware workspace.
Scan component dependencies for known CVEs and produce a vulnerability report.

plugins.name: firmware-secret-scan
plugins.description: Scan repository, configs, and firmware artifacts for secrets and tokens with automatic redaction.
plugins.longDescription: Read-only security scanner designed for firmware and embedded codebases. Detects embedded API keys, Wi-Fi credentials, private keys, and token strings across code and artifact outputs with strict finding redaction.
plugins.author: Helper Security WG
promptStarters: Scan repository source files and configuration headers for exposed credentials or secrets.

plugins.name: github-release-workflow
plugins.description: Read release evidence, draft structured release notes, and create GitHub release drafts.
plugins.longDescription: Automated GitHub release workflow skill for firmware deliveries. Parses release-evidence.json, generates formatted markdown release notes, verifies tag/checksum consistency, and creates GitHub Release drafts safely.
plugins.author: Helper Firmware WG
promptStarters: Draft GitHub release notes from release-evidence.json and verify all artifact checksums.
Create a GitHub Release draft for tag v1.0.0 with binary assets attached.

plugins.name: web-crawler
plugins.description: High-performance web scraping and crawling engine powered by Colly, Goquery, and Chromedp.
plugins.longDescription: Dual-path web extraction engine: ultra-fast static HTML scraping and Markdown conversion via Colly + Goquery, and full dynamic JavaScript/SPA rendering with screenshot support via Chromedp Headless Chrome.
plugins.author: Helper Ecosystem WG
promptStarters: Scrape documentation from a target URL and convert it to clean Markdown.
Render a dynamic JavaScript web page and extract loaded data using Headless Chrome.
Crawl pages within a documentation domain with bounded depth and rate limiting.

plugins.name: cursor-models
plugins.description: Zero-code modification provider to enable Cursor models (Claude Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.8, GPT-5.5) in Helper.
plugins.longDescription: High-performance bridge and MCP server for Cursor AI models. Connects Helper to Cursor via HTTP/2 ConnectRPC with full streaming, reasoning tokens, local Bearer token security, and automatic api-config.json registration.
plugins.author: Helper Ecosystem WG

envSpecs.name: CURSOR_AUTH_TOKEN
envSpecs.description: Optional: Explicit Cursor API Key or Auth Token. If omitted, automatically reads ~/.helper/cursor-api-key or ~/.pi/agent/auth.json.

envSpecs.name: PORT
envSpecs.description: Port for local OpenAI-compatible HTTP bridge (default: 4646).

promptStarters: Check status and active connectivity of the Cursor models bridge.
Force sync Cursor model definitions into Helper api-config.json.
Switch my active model to Cursor Claude Sonnet 4.6 for complex refactoring.

plugins.name: xlsx
plugins.description: Read, edit, create, and recalculate .xlsx/.xlsm/.csv/.tsv with live formulas (pure-Go Excelize CLI, no Python or LibreOffice).
plugins.longDescription: Recipe-first spreadsheet skill: pure-Go CLI for tabular read, live = formulas/styles/charts via Excelize, built-in formula evaluation with zero-error gate, formula-first financial-model conventions, and csv/tsv conversion.
plugins.author: Helper Ecosystem WG
promptStarters: Create a quarterly forecast workbook with live formulas and recalculate it.
Read sales.xlsx, rebuild the summary as =SUMIFS formulas, and verify zero recalc errors.
Convert this CSV to xlsx with formatted headers and live totals.
